periods.time: During Stella's early Fifth Camp defense

name.zh: 爱德怀斯指导一辉压缩魔力
name.en: Edelweiss Trains Ikki in Compressed Magic Control

periods.location: Edelweiss's home and the summit of Edelberg
periods.summary: Edelweiss invites Ikki for tea, thanks him for saving Amane Shinomiya, and refuses to simply teach him her sword because his swordsmanship has already become his own. Instead she identifies his weakness as inefficient magic use. She takes him to Edelberg's blade-like summit and sets him to balance on one finger while compressing magic into his body, forcing simultaneous precision in physical control and magic control.
periods.cause: Ikki asks for sword training before the representative war, but Edelweiss believes magic efficiency will produce greater immediate growth.
periods.process: They discuss Edelweiss's ordinary origin, her search for chivalry, and Amane; then she demonstrates the difference between flaring magic and quiet compressed magic; Ikki repeatedly falls and climbs back up using Intetsu to survive.
periods.outcome: Ikki improves toward controlling Ittou Shura's magic more efficiently and later adapts the lesson into point magic defense against Edelweiss.
periods.significance: Gives Ikki his own parallel growth during Stella's trial and provides the technique that lets him briefly stop Edelweiss.
